Payout of 28 July is short ₹6,668.00.
The bank credited ₹1,54,722.23 against an expected ₹1,61,390.23. 21 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with chargeback cb_00006 of ₹6,668.00, raised 30 July. The gateway debits a disputed amount when it receives the dispute, but books it against the cycle in which the dispute is later confirmed, so the two can fall in different payouts.
Suggested action: confirm chargeback cb_00006 against this payout and record the dispute in the books. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- cb_00006 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
